transcript: Aster laboratory demonstration. On a translation cache miss, first consult the page table. If its present bit is one, load the translation into the T L B and resume the access. No disk read is required in this case.

Now consider an absent page. The page fault handler first obtains a free frame. It then reads the requested page into that frame. Next it updates the page table, and finally restarts the interrupted instruction.
The lab records a dirty bit when a resident page has been modified. Evicting a dirty page requires writing its modified contents back to storage. A clean page does not require this write back.
